title: Cell Mitosis Stage Animation
prompt:
Use Three.js to implement simplified models of a cell, cell nucleus, and organelles, and demonstrate the visual changes across the 5 stages of mitosis.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following importmap in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
</script>

[Visual Model]
(1) Cell membrane: a large transparent or semi-transparent sphere; cell nucleus: a smaller sphere inside; organelles: several distributed small spheres/points.
(2) Five stages: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase. Each stage must have clear visual differences: for example, an intact nucleus during Interphase; disappearance of the nuclear envelope/chromosome condensation during Prophase (which may be simulated using arrangements of small cylinders/spheres); alignment at the metaphase plate during Metaphase; separation toward the two poles during Anaphase; and elongation and division into two cells during Telophase (cellCount changes to 2), etc. Implementation details may be simplified, but the stages must be visually distinguishable.

[Controls]
(3) Buttons id="nextStage" and id="prevStage" manually switch stages.
(4) Autoplay: a checkbox or button with id="autoPlay"; when true, stages automatically advance over time and either loop or stop at Telophase.
(5) The stage description panel id="stageInfo" displays the current stage name and a brief description.

[State Exposure (Required)]
Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame:
  - currentStage: number (0–4 recommended)
  - stageName: string (matching or synonymous with the five English stage names)
  - autoPlaying: boolean
  - cellCount: number (1 or 2; may be 2 after Telophase)
  - chromosomeCount: number (the number of visualized chromosome/chromatid groups; may vary by stage)
  - simTime: number (seconds)

Output a single HTML file.
